📖 Phase 1

Copilot Quick Start Guide

⏱️ 15 minutes 🎯 Get productive today

You're 15 minutes away from being productive with Copilot. This guide covers access, first prompts, and the habits that separate power users from tire-kickers.

Step 1: Access Copilot Chat

1

Open Copilot Chat

The fastest path: go directly to the M365 Copilot chat interface. Sign in with your corporate credentials.

Open Copilot Chat →

Alternative Access Points

  • Edge Browser: Click the Copilot icon in the top-right, or press Ctrl+Shift+.
  • Windows 11: Press Win+C (if enabled by IT)
  • Teams: Search "Copilot" in the apps bar
  • Bing.com: Click "Chat" (enterprise mode with work account)
💡 Pro tip: Bookmark m365.cloud.microsoft/chat — it's the cleanest interface and your conversation history persists.

Step 2: Your First Prompt

Don't overthink it. Start with something real from your actual work.

Try This I'm a product marketer at an enterprise software company. I need to write a one-paragraph positioning statement for [your product]. The target audience is [your buyer]. Key differentiators are [list 2-3]. Draft something I can refine.

Replace the bracketed sections with your specifics. Hit enter. See what comes back.

What to Notice

  • Copilot won't nail it on the first try — that's expected
  • The value is in the starting point, not the final answer
  • Your job shifts from writing to editing and directing

Step 3: Learn to Refine

The magic is in the follow-up. After the first response, try:

Refinement Prompts "Make it more specific to [industry]"

"Shorter. Two sentences max."

"Add a proof point about [specific capability]"

"Rewrite for a technical audience"

"What's weak about this positioning?"
💡 The 3-turn rule: Most good outputs come after 2-3 refinements. If you're still unhappy after 5 turns, rethink your initial prompt.

Step 4: The PMM Starter Prompts

Here are five prompts tailored for product marketing work. Try at least two today:

1. Competitive Positioning

Prompt Compare [our product] to [competitor] for a [buyer persona]. Create a table showing: key differentiators, where we win, where they win, and objection handles.

2. Meeting Prep

Prompt I have a meeting with [company name] tomorrow. They're in [industry]. Help me prepare: what are their likely priorities, what SAP products are relevant, and what questions should I ask?

3. Content Outline

Prompt Create an outline for a blog post titled "[your title]". Target audience is [persona]. Goal is to [objective]. Include suggested subheadings, key points for each section, and a CTA.

4. Email Draft

Prompt Draft an email to [recipient role] announcing [product/feature]. Keep it under 150 words. Tone should be [professional/casual/urgent]. Include one clear call to action.

5. Summarize for Exec

Prompt Summarize this document for an executive audience. Extract: the main point, 3 key takeaways, and one recommended action. Keep it under 100 words.

[paste document text]

Step 5: Build the Habit

AI fluency comes from frequency, not intensity. The goal isn't one big session — it's consistent use against real work.

✅ Week 1 Checklist

  • Access Copilot Chat successfully
  • Complete one prompt from the starter list
  • Refine a response at least 3 times
  • Use Copilot for one real deliverable
  • Complete one exercise in the Practice Lab
⚠️ Remember: No customer data, no proprietary code, no confidential information in prompts — even with enterprise Copilot. Review all outputs before sharing externally.
